parity_reason: No criterion differs by more than 1 point, both totals are 29, and neither image has a critical defect, so all three parity conditions are met.

reference.summary: A white pelican rides a red bicycle on grass under a sunny sky. It reads clearly, but the bird floats above a bike with no saddle, and its very long thin neck makes it look a bit like a stork.

defects.what: The bicycle has no saddle or seat post, so the pelican's body floats above the top tube with nothing holding it up
defects.where: the middle of the bicycle under the bird's body
defects.expected: The pelican sits on a visible saddle that is joined to the bicycle frame

defects.what: The bicycle frame is oddly built: the tubes do not form a normal triangle with a seat tube rising from the pedals to the seat
defects.expected: The frame reads as a normal bicycle, with a seat tube going up from the crank to the saddle

defects.what: The neck is very long and thin, which makes the bird look more like a stork than a pelican
defects.expected: The pelican has a shorter, thicker neck that suits a pelican

defects.what: The wing only just reaches the handlebar and does not clearly grip it
defects.where: the front of the bird's wing at the handlebar
defects.expected: The wing tip clearly rests on the handlebar

defects.what: The legs cross the frame tubes in a way that makes the crank area hard to read
defects.expected: The legs and the frame stay easy to tell apart near the pedals

attempt.summary: A grey-white pelican with a big orange beak rides a red bicycle along a road with hills and trees. It is well built and sits on a saddle, but the beak overlaps the sun.

defects.what: The beak and pouch overlap the yellow sun, so the two shapes merge and the beak's outline is hard to read
defects.expected: The beak stands out clearly against open sky, and the sun sits apart from it

defects.what: The sun sits right behind the bird's head and draws the eye away from the rider
defects.expected: The sun is placed where it does not compete with the pelican's head

defects.what: The yellow-orange beak is close in colour to the yellow sun behind it, so there is little contrast between them
defects.expected: The beak contrasts clearly with whatever lies behind it

defects.what: The wing tip only roughly meets the handlebar instead of clearly holding it
defects.where: the front of the wing at the handlebar
defects.expected: The wing tip clearly grips the handlebar

defects.what: The neck joins the body as a separate tube with a round blob at its base, which looks pasted on
defects.where: where the neck meets the body
defects.expected: The neck flows smoothly into the body
